  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelBooking" name="Travel Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_TicketSearch" name="Ticket search received">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Search" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SearchTravelOptions" name="Search flight, train or bus options">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_2</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_7</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_8</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${reminderRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_9" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TravelBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/travel-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Reminder" name="Reminder and check-in or boarding instructions"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelBooking" name="Travel Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_TravelBooking">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Process</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SearchTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectRouteDateTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvidePersonalInfo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvidePaymentDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_JourneyCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BookingSystem" name="Booking System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TicketChannelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTicketEmail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTicketSMS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TicketChannelMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateSeatInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for flight, train or bus ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRouteDateTime" name="Select route, date and time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePersonalInfo" name="Provide personal information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails" name="Provide payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TicketChannelSplit" name="Ticket sent via email or SMS?" default="Flow_SMS">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SMS</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicketEmail" name="Send ticket via email" messageRef="Msg_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmailDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicketSMS" name="Send ticket via SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SMS</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SMSDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TicketChannelMerge" name="Ticket sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EmailDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SMSDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderSplit" name="Reminders or instructions sent?" default="Flow_ReminderSkip">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReminderYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReminderSkip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send reminder and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_Reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReminderYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Before travel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReminderSkip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_JourneyCompleted" name="Customer completes journey">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Post-travel feedback or service requested?" default="Flow_FeedbackSkip">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackSkip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide post-travel feedback or service request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" name="Journey concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackSkip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Booking process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRouteDateTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectRouteDateTime" targetRef="Task_ProvidePersonalInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePersonalInfo" targetRef="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_TicketChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email" name="Email" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_SendTicketEmail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${ticketChannel == 'email'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SMS" name="SMS" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_SendTicketSMS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmailDone" sourceRef="Task_SendTicketEmail" targetRef="Gateway_TicketChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SMSDone" sourceRef="Task_SendTicketSMS" targetRef="Gateway_TicketChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketChannelMerge" targetRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderYes" name="Reminders applicable" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reminderRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderSkip" name="No reminder" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="Event_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Event_JourneyCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackYes" name="Feedback or service requested" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackOrServiceRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackSkip" name="No feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins when a participant performs an identifying or recognizing action, and then gives the steps of the work that follows: Model a plain start event that carries no action label, followed by a task named after the participant's performed action. Connect the subsequent steps after that task, in the order the description gives. Do not make the performed action a start event or label the start event with the state it produces.
rules.situation: the description says the process begins when an actor performs an initiating action such as searching, and then lists that actor's successive selections and information inputs as separate steps in a stated order before any system action

rules.instruction: When the description states, in one sentence, a step performed by an actor followed by further steps by the same actor (for example 'after doing X, the actor provides Y and Z', or 'the actor receives A and B'), so that one sentence contains an earlier action and one or more later actions joined by 'and' or commas: Model the earlier action and each later action as separate tasks, in the order the sentence gives them, and connect them in sequence. Also model each information item or sub-action named in an 'and'-joined list as its own task when the description treats it as a separate action. Name each task only after the act the description attributes to it, and do not let one task's label absorb the actions of another task.
rules.situation: the description states, in one sentence, a step performed by an actor followed by further steps by the same actor (for example 'after doing X, the actor provides Y and Z', or 'the actor receives A and B'), so that one sentence contains an earlier action and one or more later actions joined by 'and' or commas

rules.instruction: When the description states that a system generates an artifact and that this artifact is delivered to a party through one or more channels, and a later clause makes further messages to that party optional or conditional: Model a send task for the delivery step directly after the generating task, in the order the description gives, and continue the main sequence from that send task. Place any exclusive gateway that decides on further messages to the same party after the delivery task, not before it. Give each optional follow-up message its own send task on a labeled branch of that gateway, and let the delivery task remain on the path that all cases share.
rules.situation: the description states that a system generates an artifact and that this artifact is delivered to a party through one or more channels, and a later clause makes further messages to that party optional or conditional

rules.instruction: When the description states one step in which the actor chooses or sets several attributes, joined by commas or 'and' in the same clause, and the attributes are listed as separate items: Name the task for that step so that its label includes every attribute the description lists for the step, using the description's own wording for each one. Do not shorten the label to only some of the listed attributes. Keep the label in the description's language and short.
rules.situation: the description states one step in which the actor chooses or sets several attributes, joined by commas or 'and' in the same clause, and the attributes are listed as separate items

rules.instruction: When the description states that one output reaches the recipient through one of several alternative channels or methods (for example 'via A or B'), so only one channel is used per instance: Model the delivery as an exclusive gateway that routes to one send task per alternative channel, and join the branches with an exclusive gateway before the next activity. Do not model a single send task whose label merely lists the alternatives.
rules.situation: the description states that one output reaches the recipient through one of several alternative channels or methods (for example 'via A or B'), so only one channel is used per instance

rules.instruction: When the description states one sentence or step in which several distinct actions are chained on the same objects, or in which one outcome is delivered through alternative means (for example 'via X or Y'): Model each distinct action and each alternative means as its own task, in the order the description gives. If the description says one alternative is chosen, place the alternative tasks behind a decision gateway; if it does not choose, keep them as separate tasks on their own flow. Do not combine them into one task whose label lists them together.
rules.situation: the description states one sentence or step in which several distinct actions are chained on the same objects, or in which one outcome is delivered through alternative means (for example 'via X or Y')
